create_strategy_averager: create a StrategyAverager instance to compute average strategies over the entire sequence for a normal-form game
build_strategy_averager_window: build a StrategyAverager with a finite window size to average the k most recent meta-strategies per player
append_meta_strategies: append a list of per-player meta-strategy numpy arrays to the StrategyAverager for incremental averaging
compute_average_strategies: compute each player's average strategy as a list of numpy arrays from the accumulated or windowed entries
test_strategy_averager: test the StrategyAverager class with multiple append calls and verify average_strategies returns correct per-player averages
